scientific_integrity: Analytic proof for all finite n, independently supported by exact finite exhaustive computations; self-review, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only independent uniform strict student preferences, square one-to-one complete school-choice markets; independent uniform priorities for DA and serial order for RSD. Equality of distributions over random markets, not pointwise identity of matchings or envy graphs. Coupon singleton law and its exponential limit are known; only their RSD joint-inclusion connection is asserted as a contribution. Historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Exact distributional equivalence of unenvied students under deferred acceptance and random serial dictatorship
